chapter.title: OF OFFENCES AFFECTING THE HUMAN BODY

heading: Importation of girl from foreign country.
text: Whoever imports into [3][India] from any country outside India [4][or from the State of Jammu and Kashmir] any girl under the age of twenty-one years with intent that she may be, or knowing it to be likely that she will be, forced or seduced to illicit intercourse with another person, [5]***shall be punishable with imprisonment which may extend to ten years and shall also be liable to fine.]
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Indian Penal Code, 45 of 1860 (Rep., Act 45 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)
